titulo: Oura adds two new cardiovascular health tracking features to its smart rings
cuerpo: Oura is introducing two new cardiovascular-focused health tracking features to its smart rings designed to help users better understand the effect regular workouts and exercise are having on their long-term health, and whether they need to ramp it up or dial things down.
